blog.title: Big changes are coming… don't miss a thing!
blog.excerpt: A process involving a major technical migration of the current platform, and to do it with full security guarantees and without losing information, we need to carry out an orderly transition, with key dates for publishing campaigns and making donations…

matchfunding.title: Matchfunding
matchfunding.description: You'll only see the match effect on Goteo. Since 2013, we have been looking for organizations that want to multiply the impact of crowdfunding. For every euro a person contributes to a Goteo campaign, a partner institution (foundation, public administration, company…) contributes the same amount, or even more.

impact.title: Impact data
impact.description: Matchfunding not only multiplies financial resources, it also generates tangible social impact. In essence, matchfunding turns microdonations into macro impact, validating projects with citizen support and optimizing public/private resources.

hero.title: Discover our way of doing crowdfunding
hero.description: At Goteo, we believe crowdfunding is more than money: it is trust, community, and social commitment. Our crowdfunding model is based on promoting projects that generate positive impact and closely supporting the people and organizations that make them possible.

whatIs.title: What crowdfunding is
whatIs.subtitle: Real social impact.
whatIs.description: Crowdfunding is a form of financing that brings together many people who believe in an idea and decide to support it with small (or large) contributions. At Goteo, we understand it as a space where the goal is not only to raise funds, but also to create support networks, visibility, and learning.

advisory.title: Advice and support from our team
advisory.description: At Goteo, you are not alone. Our team supports you step by step, from defining your project to managing the campaign. We offer free advice to help you prepare your project. If you need more help, you can request premium personalized advice, with support materials and a proven methodology to increase your chances of success.

preparation.title: Preparation
preparation.description: Define goals, budget, duration, and communication plan. Your project may be published if it meets these criteria.

launch.title: Launch
launch.description: We activate fundraising and support you with outreach.

fundsReceived.title: Funds received
fundsReceived.description: Upon reaching the goal, complete a form and send documentation for the transfer. Ensure transparency and explain the project to the community.

followUp.title: Follow-up
followUp.description: After the campaign, share the project's progress with your donor community and close the cycle transparently.

events.title: Sign up for our training sessions and events
events.description: We regularly organize workshops, webinars, and meetups where we share lessons learned, trends, and real crowdfunding experiences. They are spaces to learn, get inspired, and connect with other people who, like you, want to turn ideas into realities. Subscribe to receive updated information through our newsletter.

taxDeductions.title: Tax deductions
taxDeductions.description: Donations on Goteo have tax benefits for both individuals and companies, thanks to the fact that we manage contributions through a foundation. This is something most platforms do not offer.

allOrNothing.title: All or nothing
allOrNothing.description: Projects receive financial support only if they prove viable and reach the minimum budget. If not, donations return to donors so they can continue supporting new initiatives.

twoRounds.title: Two co-funding rounds in 40+40 days
twoRounds.description: By default, two co-funding rounds are established, 40 days each. The first is "all or nothing", tied to the essential minimum budget; and the second is for an optimum amount, to carry out additional improvements in which everything counts.

personalizedSupport.title: Personalized support
personalizedSupport.description: We do not leave promoters on their own. Our team advises them before, during, and after the campaign, with strategic recommendations and technical support. Other platforms merely serve as a showcase for projects.

loyalCommunity.title: Loyal community
loyalCommunity.description: We have a base of recurring donors who trust Goteo and return to support campaigns because they value social and cultural impact. This gives projects more opportunities to reach their goals.

matchfunding.title: Institutional co-funding (matchfunding)
matchfunding.description: Through partnerships with institutions, we multiply citizen contributions with public or private funds. This hybrid model is unique to Goteo and does not exist on most platforms.

socialImpact.title: Focus on transformative social impact
socialImpact.description: Not all projects are accepted. At Goteo, we prioritize those aligned with the Social Economy and democratic values, whether in the form of open knowledge, community improvements, or environmental and social impact.

transparency.title: Transparency and trust
transparency.description: Campaigns go through a validation and advisory process. The community knows that published projects meet minimum standards of quality and coherence, which increases credibility.

provenMethodology.title: Proven methodology
provenMethodology.description: More than a decade of experience, with hundreds of funded projects, allows us to offer a proven methodology that increases the chances of success.
